params.body:
The balanced classify run for Mistral Medium 3.5 crashed after its first batch:

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'poem_type')
    at scoreClassify (packages/engine/eval-models.mjs:90)
```

`scoreClassify` turned an answer's `index` into a gold row with `index - 1` and checked only that the result was not below 0 or past the batch. An index that is not a number gives `NaN`, which passes both checks, and `gold[NaN]` is undefined. One answer like that ended the whole run with no score saved.

## Change

- `answerPosition(result, size, seen)` in `eval-metrics.mjs` places an answer on its gold row only when its `index` (or `id`) is a whole number from 1 to the batch size. An answer to a row that was already scored counts once, so a model that repeats an index cannot score that row twice.
- `scoreClassify` uses it and skips everything else, as it already did for out-of-range numbers.

## Tests

- `test/eval-metrics.test.mjs`: whole numbers and numeric strings are placed; 0, past the end, 2.5, a signal id, null, undefined and a repeat are not.
- Full suite: 1149 of 1155 pass. The 6 failures are the report-render tests, which need `pdftoppm` and fail the same way on main on this machine.

## After merge

```
node packages/engine/eval-models.mjs classify mistral/mistral-medium-2604 --balanced --n 100 --seed 7
```
params.title: Score a model's answer only against the gold row it names
